caption: The drawing depicts a wooden writing desk with an ornate design. The desk is shown in a three-quarter view, displaying both the front and the side. The upper section of the desk has three small, rectangular drawers with round knobs, set in a row along the top edge. Below the drawers, there is a slanted writing surface created by two large panels, each with beveled edges and outlined by darker wood grain patterns; the panels meet at the center and have a small, round handle or knob for opening. The overall color of the desk is a warm, medium brown with darker brown grain lines and shading to indicate depth and texture. The lower section features a smooth, curved apron with carved decorative detailing including a central leaf motif and leaf ornamentation on the corners. The desk stands on four curved cabriole legs, each elegantly shaped with a gentle S-curve and narrowing towards the feet. The background of the drawing is plain and light in color, allowing the details of the desk to stand out clearly.
title: Desk
